literal: On yimao day Zubu chief Chungu came to submit.
idiomatic: On yimao day Zubu chief Chungu submitted.

literal: Winter, tenth month, Song dispatched Tang Su and Ge Huaimin to come congratulate the Shuntian Festival.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Song sent Tang Su and Ge Huaimin to congratulate the Shuntian Festival.

literal: Privy Council commissioner and King of Wei Yelü Xiezhi's grandson's wife Awu reviled the imperial carriage; his grandson Guyu tried to conceal it; when the matter came out both were punished and their household was confiscated.
idiomatic: Privy Council commissioner and King of Wei Yelü Xiezhi's grandson's wife Awu reviled the imperial carriage; his grandson Guyu tried to conceal it; when the matter came out both were punished and their household was confiscated.

literal: An edict to Yan city officers and soldiers: if the enemy arrives, the garrison commander is to secure the southeast of the city, the supreme commander the northwest, cavalry and infantry to prepare for field battle, the deputy supreme commander to repair walls and ramparts and drill troops—each to train for his task.
idiomatic: An edict to Yan city officers and soldiers ordered that if the enemy arrives the garrison commander is to secure the southeast of the city, the supreme commander the northwest, cavalry and infantry to prepare for field battle, and the deputy supreme commander to repair walls and ramparts and drill troops, each training for his task.

literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day the crown prince took consort the Xiao clan.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eleventh month the crown prince took consort the Xiao clan.

literal: Yelü Qiuhan was made Northern Court king; twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, Yaolian grand marshal Xie Foliu was made Tianyun Army xiangwen.
idiomatic: Yelü Qiuhan was appointed Northern Court king; on the xinyou new moon of the twelfth month Yaolian grand marshal Xie Foliu was made Tianyun Army xiangwen.

literal: On renshen day former Northern Court king Yelü Liuning was made Shuang Prefecture military commissioner, Kang Jun Chongde Palace metropolitan garrison commander, Xie Shi Yongxing Palace metropolitan garrison commander, Lü Fen Yizhou military commissioner, An Liaozhou military commissioner, Yelü Ye concurrent Central Capital regent, and Yelü Helutu kui great general.
idiomatic: On renshen day former Northern Court king Yelü Liuning was appointed Shuang Prefecture military commissioner; Kang Jun was made Chongde Palace metropolitan garrison commander; Xie Shi Yongxing Palace metropolitan garrison commander; Lü Fen Yizhou military commissioner; An Liaozhou military commissioner; Yelü Ye concurrent Central Capital regent; and Yelü Helutu kui great general.

literal: On dingchou day an edict: though base-born offspring may have become commoners, they may not participate in household selection.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict declared that though base-born offspring may have become commoners, they may not participate in household selection.

literal: On dinghai day Song dispatched Kou Zhen and Kang De to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On dinghai day Song sent Kou Zhen and Kang De to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: Zhu Jian, Cao Ying, Zhang Yi, and Liu Yongzhao to congratulate both palaces on New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: Zhu Jian, Cao Ying, Zhang Yi, and Liu Yongzhao were to congratulate both palaces on New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: An edict: the two imperial maternal uncles and the Southern and Northern Princes' Households are the state's nobility; low-born commoners may not hold offices in those households.
idiomatic: An edict declared that the two imperial maternal uncles and the Southern and Northern Princes' Households are the state's nobility and that low-born commoners may not hold offices in those households.

literal: That year fifty-seven jinshi including Zhang You passed the examinations.
idiomatic: That year fifty-seven jinshi including Zhang You passed the examinations.

literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, returned from the Central Capital.
idiomatic: In the ninth year, during the first spring month, the court returned from the Central Capital.

literal: Second month, on wuchen day envoys were dispatched to bestow goods on Goryeo King Qin.
idiomatic: On wuchen day of the second month envoys were sent to bestow goods on Goryeo King Qin.

literal: Went to Galin River.
idiomatic: The court went to Galin River.

literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: Sixth month, on the wuzi new moon Changsha Commandery King Xiejianu was made Guangde Army military commissioner, Le'an Commandery King Suige Kuangyi Army military commissioner, Zhongshan Commandery King Zhage Baoding Army military commissioner and advanced to King of Lu, and Yuzhang King Tiebu Changning Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the sixth month Changsha Commandery King Xiejianu was appointed Guangde Army military commissioner; Le'an Commandery King Suige Kuangyi Army military commissioner; Zhongshan Commandery King Zhage Baoding Army military commissioner and advanced to King of Lu; and Yuzhang King Tiebu Changning Army military commissioner.

literal: Yelü Sizhong, Yelü He, Yelü Hao, Yaolian Xie Foliu, Chen Miao, Han Shaoyi, Han Zhibai, and Zhang Zhen were appointed envoys to congratulate Song both palaces on their birthdays and on New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: Yelü Sizhong, Yelü He, Yelü Hao, Yaolian Xie Foliu, Chen Miao, Han Shaoyi, Han Zhibai, and Zhang Zhen were appointed envoys to congratulate both Song palaces on their birthdays and on New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the wuwu new moon went to Black Ridge.
idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon of the seventh autumn month the court went to Black Ridge.

literal: Eighth month, on jichou day Eastern Capital Sheli Army xiangwen Da Yanlin imprisoned regent imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Xiaoxian and Nanyang Princess, killed Revenue Commissioner Han Shaoxun, deputy commissioner Wang Jia, and Four Expeditions Army commander-in-chief Xiao Piede; Yanlin then usurped the throne, called his state Xingliao, and took the era name Tianqing.
idiomatic: On jichou day of the eighth month Eastern Capital Sheli Army xiangwen Da Yanlin imprisoned regent imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Xiaoxian and Nanyang Princess, killed Revenue Commissioner Han Shaoxun, deputy commissioner Wang Jia, and Four Expeditions Army commander-in-chief Xiao Piede; Yanlin then usurped the throne, called his state Xingliao, and took the era name Tianqing.

literal: Initially, in Eastern Liaodong territory, since coming under allegiance at Shence there had been no monopoly sale of salt or yeast, and market tolls at passes were also very lax.
idiomatic: Initially in Eastern Liaodong territory, since coming under allegiance at Shence there had been no monopoly sale of salt or yeast, and market tolls at passes were also very lax.

literal: Feng Yanxiu and Han Shaoxun successively applied Yan's Ping Mountains regulations to constrain them; the people could not bear it.
idiomatic: Feng Yanxiu and Han Shaoxun successively applied Yan's Ping Mountains regulations to constrain them, and the people could not bear it.

literal: Yan again suffered famine year after year; Revenue Deputy Commissioner Wang Jia again proposed building ships and having locals skilled in maritime affairs transport grain by water to relieve Yan people.
idiomatic: Yan again suffered famine year after year; Revenue Deputy Commissioner Wang Jia again proposed building ships and having locals skilled in maritime affairs transport grain by water to relieve the people of Yan.

literal: Water routes were perilous and many ships sank; though people spoke of it they were not believed—whipping, beating, and plunder followed; the people resented and thought of rebellion.
idiomatic: Water routes were perilous and many ships sank; though people spoke of it they were not believed, and whipping, beating, and plunder followed until the people resented and thought of rebellion.

literal: Therefore Yanlin seized the opportunity, first killing Shaoxun and Jia to satisfy his followers.
idiomatic: Therefore Yanlin seized the opportunity, first killing Shaoxun and Jia to satisfy his followers.

literal: Yanlin had earlier plotted with deputy regent Wang Daoping; Daoping abandoned his family at night and fled over the wall, and together with Huang Pian whom Yanlin had sent to summon from Huanglong Prefecture, both reached the mobile court to report the uprising.
idiomatic: Yanlin had earlier plotted with deputy regent Wang Daoping; Daoping abandoned his family at night and fled over the wall, and together with Huang Pian, whom Yanlin had sent to summon from Huanglong Prefecture, both reached the mobile court to report the uprising.

literal: The Emperor immediately mobilized forces from all routes to advance and suppress in season.
idiomatic: The Emperor immediately mobilized forces from all routes to advance and suppress in season.

literal: At the time imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Pide was stationed near Yanlin; he first led his command and household troops to seize strategic points, cutting off his plan to cross west.
idiomatic: At the time imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Pide was stationed near Yanlin; he first led his command and household troops to seize strategic points, cutting off Yanlin's plan to cross west.

literal: Bohai Grand Guardian Xia Xingmei had also formerly commanded troops, garrisoning Ba Prefecture; Yanlin secretly sent a fast letter asking him to plot against commander Yelü Pugu.
idiomatic: Bohai Grand Guardian Xia Xingmei had also formerly commanded troops and garrisoned Ba Prefecture; Yanlin secretly sent a fast letter asking him to plot against commander Yelü Pugu.

literal: Xingmei then reported the truth; Pugu received the letter and killed eight hundred Bohai troops, cutting off the eastern route.
idiomatic: Xingmei then reported the truth; Pugu received the letter and killed eight hundred Bohai troops, cutting off the eastern route.

literal: Yanlin knew that Huanglong and Ba Prefecture would not join him, so he divided his forces west to take Shen Prefecture; its military commissioner Xiao Wangliu had just arrived, and his deputy Zhang Jie declared he wished to surrender, so they did not press the attack.
idiomatic: Yanlin knew that Huanglong and Ba Prefecture would not join him, so he divided his forces west to take Shen Prefecture; its military commissioner Xiao Wangliu had just arrived, and his deputy Zhang Jie declared he wished to surrender, so they did not press the attack.

literal: When they learned it was a ruse they already had defenses ready; they attacked but could not take it and withdrew.
idiomatic: When they learned it was a ruse the defenders were already prepared; they attacked but could not take the city and withdrew.

literal: At the time both Southern and Northern Jurchen followed Yanlin, and Goryeo also delayed its tribute.
idiomatic: At the time both Southern and Northern Jurchen followed Yanlin, and Goryeo also delayed its tribute.

literal: When forces from all routes arrived in succession, Yanlin defended the city stubbornly.
idiomatic: When forces from all routes arrived in succession, Yanlin defended the city stubbornly.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the bingxu new moon Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu was made supreme commander, imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Pide deputy supreme commander, and Xi Six Tribes king Xiao Punu inspector general to suppress him.
idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the tenth winter month Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu was appointed supreme commander, imperial maternal uncle xiangwen Xiao Pide deputy supreme commander, and Xi Six Tribes king Xiao Punu inspector general to suppress him.

literal: Eleventh month, on the yimao new moon went to Xianling.
idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the eleventh month the court went to Xianling.

literal: On bingyin day Shen Prefecture military deputy commissioner Zhang Jie was made military commissioner; twenty-two imperial city jinshi including Zhang Renji and Zhao Mu entered court.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Shen Prefecture military deputy commissioner Zhang Jie was appointed military commissioner, and twenty-two imperial city jinshi including Zhang Renji and Zhao Mu entered court.

literal: Tested with poetry and prose; all were granted ranks; Ba Prefecture garrison commander Xia Xingmei was exceptionally appointed Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner.
idiomatic: They were tested with poetry and prose; all were granted ranks, and Ba Prefecture garrison commander Xia Xingmei was exceptionally appointed Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner.

literal: On renshen day imperial son-in-law Liu Siduan was appointed acting supervisor of the Southern Court Xuanhui Bureau.
idiomatic: On renshen day imperial son-in-law Liu Siduan was appointed acting supervisor of the Southern Court Xuanhui Bureau.

literal: Twelfth month, on dingwei day Song dispatched Qiu Yong and Han Yongxi to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On dingwei day of the twelfth month Song sent Qiu Yong and Han Yongxi to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: Ordered Yelü Yu, Wu Kehe, Xiao Keguan, and Zhao Liyong as Song birthday envoys, and Yelü Yuanji, Cui Run, Xiao Zhaogu, and Dou Zhen as New Year's Day envoys for the coming year.
idiomatic: Yelü Yu, Wu Kehe, Xiao Keguan, and Zhao Liyong were ordered as Song birthday envoys, and Yelü Yuanji, Cui Run, Xiao Zhaogu, and Dou Zhen as New Year's Day envoys for the coming year.

literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, on the yimao new moon Song dispatched Wang Yijian, Dou Chuyue, Zhang Yi, and Zhang Shiyi to come congratulate.
idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, Song sent Wang Yijian, Dou Chuyue, Zhang Yi, and Zhang Shiyi to offer congratulations.

literal: Second month, visited Longhua Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the second month the court visited Longhua Prefecture.

literal: Third month, on the jiayin new moon xiangwen Xiao Pide returned from Liaodong, reporting supreme commander Xiao Xiaomu had built fortresses five li from each side of the city to besiege it.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the third month xiangwen Xiao Pide returned from Liaodong and reported that supreme commander Xiao Xiaomu had built fortresses five li from each side of the city to besiege it.

literal: Imperial son-in-law Yanning and his sister escaped through a tunnel; only Princess Cui Ba remained behind and was detected by wall defenders and stopped.
idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Yanning and his sister escaped through a tunnel; only Princess Cui Ba remained behind and was detected by the wall defenders and stopped.

literal: Summer, fourth month, went to Qianling.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court went to Qianling.

literal: Yelü Xingping was made Guangping Army military commissioner, Xia Xingmei Zhongshun Army military commissioner, Li Yanhong appointed Yizhou intendant, and Xiao Congshun promoted to Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.
idiomatic: Yelü Xingping was appointed Guangping Army military commissioner, Xia Xingmei Zhongshun Army military commissioner, Li Yanhong Yizhou intendant, and Xiao Congshun promoted to Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.

literal: Fifth month, on wushen day took summer retreat at Baipo.
idiomatic: On wushen day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Baipo.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renwu day an edict ordered civil service examinations next year.
idiomatic: On renwu day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered civil service examinations the following year.

literal: Eighth month, on bingwu day Eastern Capital rebel general Yang Xiangshi secretly sent surrender; at night he opened the south gate to admit Liao troops.
idiomatic: On bingwu day of the eighth month Eastern Capital rebel general Yang Xiangshi secretly sent surrender, and at night opened the south gate to admit Liao troops.

literal: Yanlin was captured; Bohai was pacified.
idiomatic: Yanlin was captured and Bohai was pacified.

literal: Winter, tenth month, halted at Changning Marsh.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court halted at Changning Marsh.

literal: Eleventh month, on xinhai day Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu returned victorious with eastern expedition troops, appeared before the Emperor in martial dress; the Emperor greatly feasted and rewarded him.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the eleventh month Nanjing regent Prince of Yan Xiao Xiaomu returned victorious with the eastern expedition troops and appeared before the Emperor in martial dress; the Emperor greatly feasted and rewarded him.

literal: The next day Xiao Xiaomu was made King of Dongping and Eastern Capital regent, imperial maternal uncle xiangwen and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Pide was enfeoffed as King of Lanling, and Xi king Punu was promoted to Vice Director.
idiomatic: The next day Xiao Xiaomu was made King of Dongping and Eastern Capital regent; imperial maternal uncle xiangwen and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Pide was enfeoffed as King of Lanling; and Xi king Punu was promoted to Vice Director.

literal: Acting Yanjing regent and Vice Director Xiao Hui was made Yanjing supreme commander; the former supreme commander was made great general and military commissioner; Grand Chancellor and concurrent Privy Council commissioner Ma Baozhong was appointed acting Yanjing regent; and Xi Princes' Household metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Aguzhen was made Eastern Capital supreme commander.
idiomatic: Acting Yanjing regent and Vice Director Xiao Hui was appointed Yanjing supreme commander; the former supreme commander was made great general and military commissioner; Grand Chancellor and concurrent Privy Council commissioner Ma Baozhong was appointed acting Yanjing regent; and Xi Princes' Household metropolitan garrison commander Xiao Aguzhen was made Eastern Capital supreme commander.

literal: An edict: Bohai old clans with merit and ability were appointed to office; the rest were distributed to Lai, Xi, Qian, Run, and other prefectures.
idiomatic: An edict ordered that Bohai old clans with merit and ability be appointed to office, while the rest were distributed to Lai, Xi, Qian, Run, and other prefectures.

literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day Song dispatched Mei Xun and Wang Lingjie to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the twelfth month Song sent Mei Xun and Wang Lingjie to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: Qishui Commandery King Yelü Dilie was promoted to Esteemed Father; Wugu Department military commissioner Xiao Puda was made Yishi Department king; Left Vice Minister of the Masters Xiao Lin was made Linhai Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: Qishui Commandery King Yelü Dilie was promoted to Esteemed Father; Wugu Department military commissioner Xiao Puda was made Yishi Department king; and Left Vice Minister of the Masters Xiao Lin was appointed Linhai Army military commissioner.

literal: Eleventh year, spring, first month, on the jiyou new moon went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the eleventh year, on the jiyou new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

literal: Second month, went to Changchun River.
idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Changchun River.

literal: Third month, the Emperor fell ill.
idiomatic: In the third month the Emperor fell ill.

literal: Summer, fifth month, great rains fell; all rivers flowed across the land and lost their old channels.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month great rains fell; all rivers flowed across the land and lost their old channels.

literal: Sixth month, on the dingchou new moon halted north of the Dafu River.
idiomatic: On the dingchou new moon of the sixth month the court halted north of the Dafu River.

literal: On jimao day the Emperor died at the mobile palace, age sixty-one, reigned forty-nine years.
idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor died at the mobile palace at age sixty-one, having reigned forty-nine years.

literal: In the first year of Jingfu, intercalary tenth month, on renshen day the elevated posthumous title Wenwu Daxiao Xuan Emperor was granted, temple name Shengzong.
idiomatic: In the first year of Jingfu, on renshen day of the intercalary tenth month, the posthumous title Wenwu Daxiao Xuan Emperor was elevated and the temple name Shengzong was granted.

literal: The eulogy says: Shengzong succeeded while young; government issued from the empress dowager.
idiomatic: The eulogy says: Shengzong succeeded while young, and government issued from the empress dowager.

literal: When Song forces attacked by two routes he personally donned armor; in one campaign he recovered Yan and Yun and defeated Xin and Bin; in a second he trampled Hebei—is this not magnificent!
idiomatic: When Song forces attacked by two routes he personally donned armor; in one campaign he recovered Yan and Yun and defeated Xin and Bin, and in a second he trampled Hebei—is this not magnificent!

literal: Then when extravagant desire opened, fine armies proved ill-omened; in the east was the defeat at Cha and Tuo, in the west the loss at Ganzhou—this was the fault of trusting constant victory.
idiomatic: Then when extravagant desire opened, fine armies proved ill-omened; in the east came the defeat at Cha and Tuo, in the west the loss at Ganzhou—this was the fault of trusting constant victory.

literal: Yet in his forty-nine years on the throne he cleared wrongs held over, promoted talent and conduct, scrutinized cruelty and greed, restrained extravagance and presumption, enrolled descendants of those who died in service, relieved poverty among the tribes, punished fawning disloyalty, and refused the return of Goryeo female musicians.
idiomatic: Yet in his forty-nine years on the throne he cleared wrongs held over, promoted talent and conduct, scrutinized cruelty and greed, restrained extravagance and presumption, enrolled descendants of those who died in service, relieved poverty among the tribes, punished fawning disloyalty, and refused the return of Goryeo female musicians.

literal: Among Liao emperors who reigned long and whose good names are endless, was it not Shengzong alone!
idiomatic: Among Liao emperors who reigned long and whose good names are endless, was it not Shengzong alone!
